description: This file defines the IVersionStore interface, which provides methods for accessing and managing runtime-modifiable grain interface version strategies within the Orleans framework.

classes.name: IVersionStore
classes.description: Interface for accessing and managing grain interface version strategies, including compatibility and selector strategies, with methods to retrieve these configurations.

methods.name: IsEnabled
methods.description: Property indicating whether the version store is enabled.

methods.name: GetCompatibilityStrategies
methods.description: Retrieves a dictionary mapping grain interface types to their compatibility strategies.

methods.name: GetSelectorStrategies
methods.description: Retrieves a dictionary mapping grain interface types to their version selector strategies.

methods.name: GetCompatibilityStrategy
methods.description: Retrieves the default compatibility strategy for grain interfaces.

methods.name: GetSelectorStrategy
methods.description: Retrieves the default version selector strategy for grain interfaces.
